extraction: team-agent-orchestration execution modes: (1) Sequential — one work item at a time through all agents. (2) Pipelined — multiple work items staggered (Engine on item N, Verdict on N-1, Miss on N-2). (3) Parallel — independent work items each through full agent chain. Our campaign: Pipelined across engines (Engine builds surya while Verdict verifies easyocr while Miss patches paddleocr) — optimal throughput. Sequential per engine (Engine→Verdict→Miss→Verdict).
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether pipelined execution mode maximizes our engine build throughput
